name: frida-mobile-mcp
description: Mobile Frida MCP Server - AI-powered mobile app exploration and testing via Frida instrumentation
long_description: An MCP server that drives Frida dynamic instrumentation on Android and iOS devices. It lets an AI assistant explore apps, hook Java/Objective-C/native methods, trace calls, bypass SSL pinning, inspect memory, run pre-built analysis scripts, and (optionally) automate the device UI through mobile-mcp. A device with frida-server running (or an emulator/jailbroken device) must be reachable from this machine.

device_id.title: Default Frida device ID
device_id.description: Optional device ID to use by default (e.g. emulator-5554 or a USB serial). Leave empty to auto-select / use the local device.

allow_custom_scripts.title: Allow custom Frida scripts
allow_custom_scripts.description: Allow the assistant to execute arbitrary Frida JavaScript (execute_script, custom hook_function handlers). Only enable for trusted analysis sessions.

allow_memory_write.title: Allow memory writes
allow_memory_write.description: Enable the write_memory tool, which patches process memory on the target device.

allow_native_injection.title: Allow native library injection
allow_native_injection.description: Enable the inject_library tool, which loads a native .so/.dylib into the target via Frida's injector (arbitrary native code). A capability separate from custom Frida scripts.

tools.name: get_status
tools.description: Get an overview of connected devices, active sessions (with platform, script count and last activity), hooks, traces, and the most recent session detaches / process crashes (recent_detaches)

tools.name: frida_help
tools.description: Get help on how to use frida-mobile-mcp tools

tools.name: explore_app
tools.description: Launch a mobile app and gather comprehensive initial context including loaded classes, modules, and libraries

tools.name: hook_method
tools.description: Hook a method to intercept calls with auto device/session management

tools.name: trace_method
tools.description: Trace function calls matching a pattern for a specified duration

tools.name: execute_script
tools.description: Execute a custom Frida JavaScript/TypeScript script in a target process (Frida 17 agent)

tools.name: run_prebuilt_script
tools.description: Run a pre-built Frida script from the built-in library

tools.name: search_classes_and_methods
tools.description: Search for classes and their methods by pattern in a running app

tools.name: describe_class
tools.description: Return the full shape of one loaded class: method overloads with exact parameter/return types and hook-ready signatures, constructors, fields, superclass and interfaces (ObjC: selectors with type encodings)

tools.name: discover_crypto
tools.description: Find where an app performs cryptography (or any API family) without assuming javax.crypto: ranked candidate hook targets across Java/ObjC classes and native symbols

tools.name: find_secrets_in_memory
tools.description: Scan live process memory for the STRUCTURE of secrets (not just names/byte-patterns): RC4 S-box (byte[] or Java int[256]), AES key schedule (encryption AND decryption, mode-independent), ChaCha20/Salsa20 keys (via the sigma constant), high-entropy 16/24/32-byte keys, PEM/DER private keys and JWT tokens; finds keys even when the code that uses them was never reached

tools.name: generate_memory_pattern
tools.description: Turn a located secret into a reusable anchor pattern — a stable byte signature near the key plus the offset to it — for re-locating it with scan_memory or handing it to friTap (capture_tls patterns/offsets)

tools.name: drive_coverage
tools.description: Autonomously drive an already-instrumented session's UI toward uncovered code, tapping on-screen elements breadth-first and stopping the instant a crypto/secret signal fires (or coverage stalls / max_steps); pair with monitor_crypto / trace_coverage

tools.name: monitor_crypto
tools.description: Cast a wide net over crypto: one persistent script that discovers and hooks all likely crypto sinks at once (app-owned classes, javax.crypto/Mac/MessageDigest, iOS CommonCrypto, native OpenSSL/BoringSSL) and dumps every key, input and output as hex

tools.name: trace_coverage
tools.description: Arm cheap persistent entry-hooks over a broad target set and track which are REACHED (covered) vs still COLD across trigger_and_wait drives — the reachability signal for driving an app toward unexercised code

tools.name: watch_loads
tools.description: Watch for late-loaded native libraries and Java classes, and anti-instrumentation (anti-Frida) probes, emitting events into the session message buffer

tools.name: trigger_and_wait
tools.description: Perform a UI action and wait for the resulting instrumentation output, correlating a trigger with the hooks it fires

tools.name: read_memory
tools.description: Read raw memory from a target process

tools.name: write_memory
tools.description: Write raw bytes to process memory

tools.name: scan_memory
tools.description: Scan process memory for a byte pattern

tools.name: bypass_ssl_pinning
tools.description: One-click SSL certificate pinning bypass for the target app

tools.name: capture_tls
tools.description: Capture TLS session keys (NSS key log format) and decrypted plaintext from the target using the friTap agent (OpenSSL/BoringSSL, Conscrypt, NSS, GnuTLS, wolfSSL, mbedTLS, Secure Transport, ...)

tools.name: get_messages
tools.description: Retrieve buffered messages from active scripts and hooks

tools.name: stop_instrumentation
tools.description: Clean up all hooks, scripts, and traces on a target

tools.name: unload_script
tools.description: Unload a single script (hook, trace or custom script) from a session while keeping the session attached

tools.name: mobile_action
tools.description: Gateway to mobile-mcp UI automation tools

tools.name: detect_app_technologies
tools.description: Detect what libraries, frameworks, and security mechanisms an app uses

tools.name: validate_script
tools.description: Check a Frida script for syntax, type and Frida 17 API problems without a device

tools.name: list_devices
tools.description: Enumerate all Frida-visible devices including local, USB, and remote devices

tools.name: select_device
tools.description: Explicitly select the active Frida device for subsequent operations.

tools.name: get_device_info
tools.description: Get detailed information about a device including OS version, architecture, and system parameters.

tools.name: list_processes
tools.description: List running processes on the target device

tools.name: list_applications
tools.description: List installed and running applications on the target device.

tools.name: get_frontmost_application
tools.description: Get the currently foreground application on the device.

tools.name: spawn_process
tools.description: Spawn a new process in suspended state for early instrumentation

tools.name: attach_process
tools.description: Attach to an already running process by PID or name.

tools.name: resume_process
tools.description: Resume a suspended process (after spawn_process).

tools.name: kill_process
tools.description: Kill a process on the target device.

tools.name: detach_session
tools.description: Detach from a specific Frida session, unloading all scripts.

tools.name: list_sessions
tools.description: List all active Frida sessions managed by this server.

tools.name: spawn_gating
tools.description: Enable, disable, or list device-wide spawn gating to hold newly spawned (incl. child/isolated) processes suspended for early instrumentation

tools.name: child_gating
tools.description: Enable or disable child gating on a session so forked/exec'd child processes are held for instrumentation

tools.name: eternalize_script
tools.description: Pin a loaded script in the target so it survives session detach (fire-and-forget: no more messages or unload afterwards)

tools.name: enumerate_modules
tools.description: List loaded modules (shared libraries) in the target process with name, base, end (base+size), size and path

tools.name: enumerate_exports
tools.description: List exports (functions and variables) of a specific module, paginated with offset/limit

tools.name: enumerate_imports
tools.description: List imports of a specific module (functions it calls in other libraries), paginated with offset/limit

tools.name: enumerate_symbols
tools.description: List symbols (including non-exported/debug symbols) of a specific module

tools.name: hook_function
tools.description: Low-level hook with custom onEnter/onLeave JavaScript handlers

tools.name: unhook_function
tools.description: Remove a specific hook by its hook ID.

tools.name: resolve_address
tools.description: Translate between absolute process addresses and static-analysis coordinates

tools.name: analyze_native_function
tools.description: Static-style analysis of a native function at runtime: function range (Process.findFunctionRange), basic blocks and edges (Frida 17.12+ ControlFlowGraph; falls back to linear disassembly until the fir

tools.name: dump_module_memory
tools.description: Dump a loaded module from process memory to a file on the host (e.g

tools.name: list_threads
tools.description: List the threads of the target process (id, name, state, current pc as module+0xoffset)

tools.name: frida_server_status
tools.description: Report whether frida-server is running on an Android device (via adb): PIDs, device CPU ABI, matching frida release arch, and the GitHub .xz asset URL to download for the installed frida-node version

tools.name: frida_server_install
tools.description: Push a local frida-server binary to an Android device and chmod it executable (adb push + chmod 755)

tools.name: frida_server_start
tools.description: Start frida-server detached on an Android device (daemonized, optionally via su) with a custom listen address/port/binary name, then confirm it came up

tools.name: frida_server_stop
tools.description: Stop frida-server on an Android device by signalling the matching process (adb shell pkill, optionally via su)

tools.name: adb_shell
tools.description: Run an arbitrary shell command on an Android device via adb shell; disabled by default, requires allowAdbShell

tools.name: adb_logcat
tools.description: Dump the last N lines of the Android logcat (one-shot), optionally filtered, or clear the buffer

tools.name: adb_pull
tools.description: Pull a file from an Android device to the host (adb pull)

tools.name: adb_push
tools.description: Push a file from the host to an Android device (adb push)

tools.name: adb_forward
tools.description: Manage adb port forwards (add, remove, or list) to reach a frida-server on a non-default device port

tools.name: inject_library
tools.description: Inject a native library (.so/.dylib) from the host into a target process via Frida's injector, independent of the JS engine (disabled by default; requires allowNativeInjection and an architecture-matched library)

tools.name: search_recipes
tools.description: Search the purpose-indexed library of ready-to-run classic-JS Frida recipes (custom crypto-key capture, native/JNI hooks, classloader/intent/WebView, iOS Keychain); returns ranked recipes with source to adapt and run via execute_script

tools.name: save_script
tools.description: Save a Frida script under ~/.config/frida-mobile-mcp/scripts for reuse (requires allowCustomScripts)

tools.name: list_saved_scripts
tools.description: List Frida scripts previously saved with save_script

tools.name: run_saved_script
tools.description: Run a previously saved Frida script by name against a target (requires allowCustomScripts)

tools.name: export_script
tools.description: Export a Frida script as a standalone classic .js that runs under the plain 'frida -U -f <pkg> -l file.js' CLI (preamble + source; bridges provided by the frida-tools CLI, not bundled)
